title: 第一章 魔族太女——枫溪
slug: 神印我魔族太女重铸魔族
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“皇姐。”

“母亲，她要走了。”

“她不要我们了。”

年仅八岁的阿宝看着十六岁的枫溪。

他伸出藕节似的小手，粉雕玉琢的小脸上是沮丧的神情。

他的声音酥酥的，软软的，像是在跟枫溪撒娇。

枫溪和阿宝是同父同母的姐弟。

他们的母亲是如今的魔后，也是逆天魔龙族血脉纯正的一员。

只是，他们并不受宠。

当然，作为逆天魔龙族第一个纯血子嗣，枫溪的地位还是很不错。

可他还是一个孩子，并不能掩盖自己的悲伤。

他垂头丧气，像是霜打的茄子般的蔫蔫的。

枫溪敛眸，澄澈的蓝眸内是平静的情绪，“这是她的选择。”

“阿宝，我们是逆天魔龙族，我们骨子里流淌的就是冰冷的血脉。”

他们的骨子里流淌着的冰冷情感。

身为逆天魔龙族魔神皇枫秀的第一个纯血女儿，枫溪自然是他皇位的第一顺位继承人，也就是逆天魔龙族的太女。

逆天魔龙族是以血脉为重的种族。

正因为如此，枫溪比阿宝更能接受自己母亲的离去。

因为她很早之前就意识到了他们之间并不相爱。

他们是为了繁衍种族的血脉才成为夫妻。

他们的父皇给予了他们的母亲最大的体面。

如今，这份体面因为一个人类的到来而被破坏。

枫溪摸着阿宝的脑袋，轻声道：“早点睡吧。”

“明日我还有事情要去处理。”

意外得知自己还有一个年长两岁的姐姐，枫溪的感受是异常复杂的。

她这个名义上同父异母的姐姐是一个人魔混血儿。

“好吧。”

阿宝垂着小脸，看起来情绪不高，一副委屈的样子。

枫溪摸着他的脑袋，安抚着他的情绪。

“你要是害怕，晚上就在我这边睡。”

枫溪看着自己弟弟那可怜兮兮的样子，还是没能狠下心来。

反正喊人置办一张小床让他来睡，对枫溪来说是一件简单的小事。

content_en:
Page (1/3)

"Sister Royal."

"Mother, she is leaving."

"She doesn't want us anymore."

Bao, who was only eight years old, looked at Fengxi, who was sixteen years old.

He stretched out his little hands like lotus root joints, and his pink and jade-carved little face showed a frustrated look.

His voice was crisp and soft, as if he was coquettishly talking to Feng Xi.

Fengxi and Abao are siblings with the same father and mother.

Their mother is the current Demon Queen and a pure-blooded member of the Heaven-defying Demonic Dragon Clan.

However, they are not favored.

Of course, as the first pure-blooded descendant of the Heaven-defying Demonic Dragon Clan, Fengxi's status is still very good.

But he was still a child and could not hide his sadness.

He was dejected, as wilted as an eggplant beaten by frost.

Fengxi narrowed her eyes, her clear blue eyes filled with calm emotions, "This is her choice."

"Abao, we are from the Heaven-defying Demonic Dragon Clan, and we have cold blood flowing in our bones."

The cold emotion that runs through their bones.

As the first pure-blood daughter of the Demon God Emperor Fengxiu of the Heaven-defying Demonic Dragon Clan, Fengxi is naturally the first heir to his throne, that is, the princess of the Heaven-Defying Demonic Dragon Clan.

The Heaven-defying Demonic Dragon Clan is a race that values ​​bloodline.

Because of this, Fengxi is more able to accept his mother's death than Abao.

Because she realized a long time ago that they didn't love each other.

They became husband and wife in order to propagate the blood of the race.

Their father treated their mother with the utmost dignity.

Now, this dignity has been destroyed by the arrival of a human being.

Fengxi touched Abao's head and whispered, "Go to bed early."

"I still have things to deal with tomorrow."

Fengxi unexpectedly learned that she had a sister who was two years older than her. Fengxi's feelings were extremely complicated.

Her nominal half-sister is a human-demon hybrid.

"Okay."

A Bao's face was downcast, looking depressed and aggrieved.

Fengxi touched his head and calmed his emotions.

"If you are scared, sleep here with me at night."

Fengxi looked at his brother's pitiful look, but still couldn't calm down.

Anyway, asking someone to buy a small bed for him to sleep on was a simple matter for Fengxi.
